description: Get per-video performance snapshots (views, likes, comments, saves) of published posts for one window (24h, 7d or 28d), newest first, optionally filtered by persona, account, provider (network) and script angle. YouTube rows also carry YouTube Analytics retention for the user's own videos: engagedViews, stayedToWatchPct (derived: engaged views / views), averageViewPercentage, contentType, provisional (data may still change), and analyticsStatus (scope_missing = the user must reconnect YouTube). Returns rows plus truncated (true when more rows exist than the server cap).

account.description: Optional publishing account id filter (the account ids from list_social_accounts).

angle.description: Optional script angle filter (exact match), or ^@none for posts with no angle.

persona.description: Optional persona id filter (uuid from list_personas), or ^@none for posts with no persona.

window.description: Snapshot window: 24h (first day after publishing), 7d (first week) or 28d (four weeks; YouTube Analytics values are final).

name: get_post_metrics
